title: Prune transcript repair generations and fence stale in-flight cleanup
outcome: Dirty-session and in-flight repair bookkeeping remains bounded across deletion and server epochs without stale cleanup disrupting a newer request.
acceptance: Removed sessions are pruned from dirty authority and in-flight repair bookkeeping; steady-state deltas do not incur full-session scanning solely for removed dirty entries.
Server-epoch change and delayed old-request finally cannot clear a newer request's in-flight ownership; a regression checks bounded request counts and convergence.
